description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EducationDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods such as add, edit, get, delete, and validate existence of education records in the database.

classes.name: EducationDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the EducationDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes the EducationDao instance, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testAddEducation
methods.description: Tests the saving of a new Education record.

methods.name: testEditEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Education record.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests fetching an Education record by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Education records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple Education records by their IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion attempt with non-existing record IDs.

methods.name: testIsExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks the existence of an Education name, case-insensitive and trimmed.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Education by name, including variations in case and whitespace.
